counting_rule: A unit counts only if it owns a distinct falsifiable hypothesis, an executable component, a reproduction, a test, an adversarial case or an acceptance decision, and leaves a durable result verified by hash on read-back. Renamed clones, inventories, plans, idle sessions and duplicated summaries do not count.

functions.F2: zero-base strategy challenge, alternative generation and opportunity discovery
functions.F4: controlled reproduction of external claims on sanitized Obzio workloads
functions.F5: independent evaluation, adversarial review and hidden-case generation
functions.F6: model, tool, runtime, context, memory, coordination and topology evaluation
functions.F10: open discovery of useful work neither the founder nor this commission named

units.hypothesis: A hash-chained append-only ledger detects every single-row mutation, reordering and truncation without any external store.

acceptance.assertion: A randomized property test applies at least 1000 distinct tamper operations and the chain verifier flags 100% of them with zero false positives on untampered ledgers.
acceptance.falsified_if: any tamper class passes verification or a clean ledger is reported invalid

units.hypothesis: A transactional outbox with idempotency keys converts at-least-once delivery into exactly-once observable effect.

acceptance.assertion: Replaying the same outbox record three times, including interleaved and concurrent replays, produces exactly one external effect and two recorded DUPLICATE_IGNORED observations.
acceptance.falsified_if: a replay produces a second effect or the duplicate is silently dropped without a ledger observation

units.hypothesis: Monotonic fence tokens make it impossible for an evicted leaseholder to commit after ownership transfers.

acceptance.assertion: After a lease is re-granted, a commit attempt carrying the older fence token is rejected and recorded as FENCE_REJECTED, while the current holder commits successfully.
acceptance.falsified_if: a stale fence commit is admitted or the rejection is not durably recorded

units.hypothesis: Heartbeat lease renewal plus monotonic checkpoints lets an interrupted unit resume from its last checkpoint instead of restarting.

acceptance.assertion: A unit killed after checkpoint N resumes at N, not 0, and never re-executes an already committed step.
acceptance.falsified_if: resume restarts from zero or repeats a committed step

units.hypothesis: The work-unit registry is a pure projection of the ledger, so deleting it loses no state.

acceptance.assertion: Deleting the registry and rebuilding it from the ledger alone yields byte-identical content across at least 50 randomized event histories.
acceptance.falsified_if: any rebuild differs by a single byte

units.hypothesis: Two-phase result staging makes partial writes unobservable to the parent.

acceptance.assertion: A fault injected between stage and commit leaves the unit recoverable and never observable as RESULT_COMMITTED, for every injection point.
acceptance.falsified_if: any injection point yields an observable committed state with incomplete bytes

units.hypothesis: A content-addressed artifact store detects single-bit corruption and truncation on read-back.

acceptance.assertion: Bit-flip and truncation fixtures are rejected at read-back with 100% detection and a precise diagnostic naming the artifact.
acceptance.falsified_if: a corrupted artifact is accepted or the diagnostic omits the artifact identity

units.hypothesis: Coordinator-only completion is enforced structurally rather than by convention, so no worker-authored document can reach COMPLETED.

acceptance.assertion: Every attempt to reach COMPLETED without a prior verified PARENT_INGESTED event, or with a non-coordinator actor, is rejected; an exhaustive state-transition test covers all fifteen Obzio states.
acceptance.falsified_if: any path reaches COMPLETED without coordinator ingestion

units.hypothesis: Worker process or session loss mid-execution is fully recoverable from immutable input with no false completion.

acceptance.assertion: Injected process loss at each state transition yields automatic re-lease and rerun from immutable input, zero units observable as COMPLETED, and a recorded recovery time.
acceptance.falsified_if: any injected loss produces a COMPLETED unit or an unrecoverable unit

units.hypothesis: A lost return message never loses a committed result, because the parent reconciles from the durable sink rather than the callback.

acceptance.assertion: Dropping 100% of return callbacks still yields 100% recovery of committed results by scanner reconciliation, with no founder relay.
acceptance.artifact: matrix row plus recovery scanner test
acceptance.falsified_if: any committed result is unrecoverable without the callback

units.hypothesis: A partial write is always detected and never ingested.

acceptance.assertion: Truncated artifacts and half-written manifests are rejected at ingestion by byte-count and hash reconciliation in 100% of injected cases.
acceptance.falsified_if: a partially written artifact is ingested

units.hypothesis: Failure immediately before and immediately after the result commit are distinguishable and both recoverable without duplicate external effect.

acceptance.assertion: Pre-commit failure reruns; post-commit failure resumes and ingests the existing commit exactly once; no duplicate effect in either case.
acceptance.falsified_if: a post-commit failure causes rerun that duplicates the effect

units.hypothesis: Failure immediately before and after the push are both recoverable and never leave the parent believing in a result that no remote holds.

acceptance.assertion: Pre-push failure yields PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED and rerun; post-push failure is reconciled from the remote by immutable SHA.
acceptance.falsified_if: the parent records a durable locator that the remote does not contain

units.hypothesis: A stale lease holder is evicted deterministically and cannot commit afterwards.

acceptance.assertion: Lease expiry triggers LEASE_EXPIRED and re-lease with a higher fence; the evicted worker's later commit is rejected in 100% of trials.
acceptance.falsified_if: an evicted worker commits or eviction is nondeterministic

units.hypothesis: Duplicate callbacks are harmless under concurrency, not merely under sequential replay.

acceptance.assertion: Concurrent duplicate ingestion of an identical result yields exactly one PARENT_INGESTED row and no ledger chain break, across at least 200 interleavings.
acceptance.falsified_if: two ingestion rows appear or the chain breaks

units.hypothesis: A corrupt or missing artifact is always caught before completion, never after.

acceptance.assertion: Corruption and deletion fixtures are rejected at ingestion with 100% detection and the unit is returned to RECOVERY_REQUIRED.
acceptance.falsified_if: a corrupt or missing artifact reaches COMPLETED

units.hypothesis: Network interruption during push or fetch degrades throughput but never correctness.

acceptance.assertion: Injected interruption yields bounded retry with backoff and zero corrupted or partially recorded results.
acceptance.falsified_if: an interruption produces an inconsistent durable state

units.hypothesis: A parent restart with zero in-memory state reconstructs the exact fleet state from the ledger.

acceptance.assertion: After discarding all parent memory, the rebuilt projection equals the pre-restart projection byte for byte, and in-flight units resume.
acceptance.falsified_if: the rebuilt projection differs or an in-flight unit is orphaned

units.hypothesis: Entire provider-runtime loss is survivable because every durable result lives in the git remote, not the provider.

acceptance.assertion: Simulating total runtime loss and rebuilding from a fresh clone recovers 100% of committed results and correctly classifies uncommitted ones as PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED.
acceptance.artifact: matrix row plus clean-clone recovery test
acceptance.falsified_if: any committed result is unrecoverable from the remote alone

units.hypothesis: The lost PO-02 Code-2 packaging return, replayed as a fixture against this control plane, is classified as PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED and never as a deliverable.

acceptance.assertion: The Code-2 fixture is rejected as completion, retained as a fault fixture, and drives an automatic rerun-from-immutable-input path; the recovery receipt records the full matrix with zero false completions.
acceptance.falsified_if: the fixture is admitted as a completed deliverable or the matrix has an untested fault class

units.hypothesis: The complete PO-03 suite runs from a fresh clone with no warm checkout, no provider memory, no /tmp state and no uncommitted files.

acceptance.assertion: A scripted clean-clone runner clones into a fresh directory, runs every PO-03 test, and exits zero with a recorded command transcript and hashes.
acceptance.falsified_if: the suite depends on anything outside the committed tree

units.hypothesis: A static hermeticity prober can detect non-portable dependencies in PO-03 tooling before they reach CI.

acceptance.assertion: The prober flags absolute paths, /tmp usage, HOME dependence, network calls and environment reads across all PO-03 Python sources, with a deliberate non-portable fixture proving detection and zero findings on the real tree.
acceptance.falsified_if: a planted non-portable pattern is missed

units.hypothesis: A CI path-scope guard fails the build for any write outside the wave-one allowlist.

acceptance.assertion: The workflow computes changed paths against the merge base and fails on out-of-allowlist writes; a deliberate out-of-allowlist mutation fixture is included and proven to be rejected by the same code path CI runs.
acceptance.falsified_if: the fixture passes or the guard only runs on a subset of events

units.hypothesis: A clean GitHub Actions environment reproduces the entire PO-03 suite without repository-local scaffolding.

acceptance.assertion: A workflow runs the full suite on a clean runner and records the run URL, conclusion and duration in the CI receipt.
acceptance.falsified_if: the workflow needs a preinstalled dependency or a warm cache

units.hypothesis: PO-03 generated artifacts are byte-deterministic across runs once timestamps are excluded by contract.

acceptance.assertion: Two independent runs produce byte-identical artifacts for every non-timestamp field, and the timestamp fields are explicitly enumerated rather than incidental.
acceptance.falsified_if: an undeclared field varies between runs

units.hypothesis: The suite passes with network access removed, proving no hidden remote dependency.

acceptance.assertion: Running the suite with outbound network disabled still exits zero, and any test that genuinely needs the remote is explicitly marked and separated.
acceptance.falsified_if: an unmarked test fails without network

units.hypothesis: An uncommitted-file gate prevents claims that depend on files never pushed, which is the exact way the Code-2 return was lost.

acceptance.assertion: The gate fails when the working tree is dirty or when a manifest references an untracked path, with a fixture proving each case.
acceptance.falsified_if: a manifest referencing an untracked file passes

units.hypothesis: Process-boundary isolation, not in-process import, is required for honest portable execution claims.

acceptance.assertion: A subprocess-boundary harness runs every PO-03 entry point as a separate process with a clean environment, and at least one in-process-only assumption is found and either fixed or recorded as a boundary.
acceptance.falsified_if: the harness cannot distinguish in-process from subprocess success

units.hypothesis: Every PO-01 source needed for qualification can be pinned to an immutable SHA without contacting or mutating PO-01.

acceptance.assertion: source-lock.json pins exact commit SHAs for each PO-01 pack branch observed read-only, records the observation method, and contains zero writes to PO-01 refs.
acceptance.falsified_if: any ref is recorded by branch name only, or any PO-01 ref is written

units.hypothesis: Freezing evaluation criteria and expected evidence before reading producer narratives changes the qualification outcome relative to narrative-first review.

acceptance.assertion: criteria-freeze.json is committed with its own hash before any producer narrative is read, and the commit ordering is provable from git history.
acceptance.falsified_if: git history shows narrative reading before criteria freeze

units.hypothesis: An independent pack qualifier detects files a manifest claims but the tree does not contain.

acceptance.assertion: The qualifier reports every manifest entry with no corresponding blob at the pinned SHA, proven by a synthetic missing-file fixture and then run against the real pinned packs.
acceptance.falsified_if: a planted missing file is not reported

units.hypothesis: Non-portable paths inside operator packs can be detected mechanically from the pinned tree.

acceptance.assertion: The detector flags absolute paths, machine-specific roots and unresolvable relative references, validated against a planted fixture and then reported for the real packs.
acceptance.falsified_if: a planted non-portable path is missed

units.hypothesis: Manifest and provenance gaps are detectable as a closed set: unlisted files, unhashed entries, and hash mismatches.

acceptance.assertion: The enforcement tool reports all three gap classes with a fixture for each and a real run against the pinned packs.
acceptance.falsified_if: any gap class lacks a proving fixture

units.hypothesis: Pack claims that hold in-process fail across a real process boundary.

acceptance.assertion: Executing pack entry points as isolated subprocesses from a clean checkout either reproduces the claim or produces a frozen failing test; the outcome is recorded either way.
acceptance.falsified_if: the run cannot distinguish reproduction from producer narrative

units.hypothesis: Transport debris is mechanically distinguishable from live repository content.

acceptance.assertion: The detector classifies _transport and comparable staging residue with a stated rule, reports counts and locations read-only, and proposes disposition without deleting anything.
acceptance.falsified_if: the classification is manual or the tool mutates any path outside the allowlist

units.hypothesis: Current-source and supersession state can be compiled mechanically from the repository rather than asserted in prose.

acceptance.assertion: A compiler resolves the current pointer chain from operations/README.md through the active instruction stack, emits repository-disposition.json with an explicit disposition for every superseded launch surface, and its output is reproducible from a clean clone.
acceptance.falsified_if: the compiler needs manual input or its output varies between clean runs

units.hypothesis: Durable-execution workflow engines converge on a small invariant set (idempotency key, fence, checkpoint, outbox) that predicts which of our fault classes are survivable.

acceptance.assertion: A frozen hypothesis names the invariant set, an Obzio reproduction tests it against our fault matrix, and the result either changes a live mechanism or is rejected with evidence.
acceptance.falsified_if: the hypothesis remains a summary with no reproduction

units.hypothesis: Content-addressed result custody outperforms message-passing return for multi-agent fleets under callback loss.

acceptance.assertion: A reproduction measures recovery rate under injected callback loss for both designs on the same workload and reports the difference.
acceptance.falsified_if: no measured difference is produced

units.hypothesis: Blind cross-family adversarial review catches a materially different defect class than same-family review.

acceptance.assertion: Defects found by cross-family reviewers are classified and compared against same-family findings on identical artifacts.
acceptance.artifact: reproduction-ledger.jsonl row plus classified defect table
acceptance.falsified_if: the comparison is not run on identical artifacts

units.hypothesis: Bounded hashed context capsules beat whole-tree context dumping on accepted-result rate at equal reasoning setting.

acceptance.assertion: A matched comparison on the same units measures acceptance and defect rate for capsule versus dump admission.
acceptance.falsified_if: context admission is not actually varied between arms

units.hypothesis: Preregistered acceptance criteria reduce escaped defects relative to criteria written after seeing the result.

acceptance.assertion: Escaped-defect counts are compared between preregistered and post-hoc criteria arms on comparable units.
acceptance.falsified_if: only one arm is measured

units.hypothesis: Property-based and metamorphic testing find custody defects that example-based tests miss.

acceptance.assertion: A dependency-free property harness is run against the control plane and the incremental defect count over the example suite is reported.
acceptance.artifact: runnable property harness plus reproduction row
acceptance.falsified_if: the harness duplicates existing example assertions

units.hypothesis: Deterministic simulation testing of the whole fleet exposes interleavings that sequential fault injection cannot reach.

acceptance.assertion: A seeded deterministic scheduler replays fleet histories and finds at least one interleaving-only defect or proves none exists within the explored space, with the seed and space size recorded.
acceptance.falsified_if: the explored space is not quantified

units.hypothesis: Lease TTL tuning has a measurable optimum for this workload rather than being an arbitrary constant.

acceptance.assertion: Recovery time and false-eviction rate are measured across at least four TTL values and an evidence-backed value is retained or the parameter is recorded as insensitive.
acceptance.falsified_if: a TTL is chosen without measurement

units.hypothesis: Producer self-certification is the dominant source of false completion, above tooling defects.

acceptance.assertion: The PO-02 causal defect list is coded against observed Wave A events and the relative contribution is reported with counts.
acceptance.falsified_if: the analysis is qualitative only

units.hypothesis: An append-only event log with projections is a better state contract for this programme than mutable status files.

acceptance.assertion: The two designs are compared on recovery, auditability and collision count using the same Wave A history.
acceptance.falsified_if: the mutable-file arm is not actually executed

units.hypothesis: Structured hypothesis registration before execution raises the research-to-mechanism conversion rate.

acceptance.assertion: Conversion rate is computed for registered versus unregistered hypotheses within this wave.
acceptance.artifact: computed conversion rate plus reproduction row
acceptance.falsified_if: conversion is asserted without a denominator

units.hypothesis: At least two admitted external methods survive independent recurrence testing after changing a live PO-03 mechanism.

acceptance.assertion: Two or more mechanism changes are made, independently recurrence-tested by a different owner, and each receives RETAIN, DELETE, SUPERSEDE, RETEST or REJECT with lineage.
acceptance.artifact: live diff plus recurrence tests plus dispositions
acceptance.falsified_if: fewer than two mechanism changes are independently tested

units.hypothesis: Criteria frozen before any producer conclusion is visible will reject at least one claim that a narrative-first review would accept.

acceptance.assertion: Frozen criteria for the custody engine are committed and hashed before reading a1 output, provable from git history.
acceptance.falsified_if: git history shows the criteria were written after reading a1 conclusions

units.hypothesis: Hidden adversarial cases withheld from producers will fail at a higher rate than producer-authored cases.

acceptance.assertion: A withheld case set is authored against the fault matrix without seeing a2 tests, then executed; pass rates for hidden versus producer cases are reported.
acceptance.falsified_if: hidden cases are derived from producer tests

units.hypothesis: A false-green detector can find tests that pass without asserting the property they claim.

acceptance.assertion: The detector mutates the implementation and reports any test that still passes; at least one tautological or under-asserting test is found or the suite is proven mutation-resistant on the mutated set.
acceptance.falsified_if: the detector never actually mutates the implementation

units.hypothesis: The clean-clone reproduction claim from a3 is escapable, meaning a defect exists that clean-clone testing does not catch.

acceptance.assertion: An independent attempt to break the clean-clone claim either finds an escape or records the exact attack surface explored and the boundary reached.
acceptance.falsified_if: the attempt is a review opinion with no executed probe

units.hypothesis: At least one Wave A unit will claim a durable result whose artifacts do not survive independent read-back by immutable SHA.

acceptance.assertion: Every claimed result is re-read from the remote by SHA by this reviewer, independently of the coordinator, and discrepancies are reported; the count is stated even if zero.
acceptance.falsified_if: the audit trusts the coordinator's own ingestion record

units.hypothesis: Independent disposition of Claude-produced cohorts will reject or return at least one unit, demonstrating the review is not ceremonial.

acceptance.assertion: Each reviewed unit receives ACCEPTED or REJECTED with a rationale tied to frozen criteria; the reviewer is never the producer.
acceptance.artifact: disposition rows in the ledger plus receipts
acceptance.falsified_if: every unit is accepted without a rationale referencing the frozen criteria

units.hypothesis: Every metric the commission requires can be defined before optimisation, with an explicit NOT_SUPPORTED boundary for values this runtime cannot supply.

acceptance.assertion: metric-definitions.json defines each required metric with formula, source field and availability, and is committed before any metric value is computed.
acceptance.falsified_if: a metric is computed before it is defined, or an unavailable value is invented

units.hypothesis: One measurement row per counted unit can be derived entirely from the ledger, with no self-reported values.

acceptance.assertion: work-unit-runs.jsonl is generated from the ledger by a tool, covers 100% of counted units, and regenerating it is byte-stable.
acceptance.falsified_if: any row contains a value not derivable from the ledger

units.hypothesis: Independently accepted throughput, first-pass acceptance and escaped-defect rate are computable without any invented denominator.

acceptance.assertion: Each reported rate states its numerator and denominator explicitly and the computation is reproducible from committed inputs.
acceptance.falsified_if: a rate is reported without an explicit denominator

units.hypothesis: Token and monetary cost per unit are not exposed to this runtime and must be recorded as NOT_SUPPORTED with the observed boundary rather than estimated.

acceptance.assertion: An explicit probe for cost and token telemetry is attempted and its exact outcome recorded; if unavailable, NOT_SUPPORTED is recorded with the boundary and no estimate appears anywhere.
acceptance.artifact: probe result plus metric availability table
acceptance.falsified_if: any cost figure is estimated

units.hypothesis: Coordination overhead is a measurable fraction of wall time rather than an intuition.

acceptance.assertion: Queue, active, wall and review time are derived per unit from ledger timestamps and coordination overhead is reported as a computed ratio.
acceptance.falsified_if: overhead is asserted without per-unit timestamps

units.hypothesis: Per-model contribution and cross-family disagreement are measurable from dispositions and defect attribution.

acceptance.assertion: Contribution and disagreement are computed per exact model slug from committed dispositions, with counts and no attribution to Auto.
acceptance.falsified_if: any unit lacks an exact model slug attribution

units.hypothesis: G0, the pre-amendment controller, is reconstructible as executable code from immutable source rather than described in prose.

acceptance.assertion: workstreams/po03/successor/g0/ contains a runnable controller reconstructed from the pinned pre-amendment commit and passes the frozen suite at whatever level it actually reaches.
acceptance.falsified_if: G0 is a document rather than executable code

units.hypothesis: G1, this transactional factory, is packageable as an executable generation artifact independent of the live tree.

acceptance.assertion: workstreams/po03/successor/g1/ runs the same frozen suite from its own entry point with recorded results.
acceptance.falsified_if: G1 cannot run without the live control directory

units.hypothesis: A frozen public suite plus evaluator-held novel cases can separate genuine capability from suite overfitting.

acceptance.assertion: The public suite is frozen and hashed, and holdout cases are authored by a different owner and withheld until scoring.
acceptance.falsified_if: the holdout author is the same owner as the generation author

units.hypothesis: G2, compiled only from G1 failures and independently accepted lessons, outperforms G1 on the holdout without quality regression.

acceptance.assertion: G2 is executable, its lineage to specific G1 failures is explicit, and it is scored on the same suite and holdout as G0 and G1.
acceptance.falsified_if: G2 contains changes with no traceable G1 failure or accepted lesson

units.hypothesis: Measured lift across G0 to G2 either exists on preregistered metrics or must be reported as NOT_YET.

acceptance.assertion: generation-comparison.json reports scores for all three generations on identical inputs and states PASS or NOT_YET on the preregistered lift metric with no quality regression permitted.
acceptance.falsified_if: lift is claimed without a preregistered metric or with an unreported regression

units.hypothesis: At least three independently supported lessons can change live mechanisms and survive recurrence testing.

acceptance.assertion: Three or more lessons each produce a live mechanism change, a recurrence test authored by a different owner, and a RETAIN, DELETE, SUPERSEDE, RETEST or REJECT disposition preserving lineage.
acceptance.artifact: lesson-to-change lineage table plus recurrence tests
acceptance.falsified_if: fewer than three lessons reach a live tested change

units.hypothesis: A zero-base challenge will identify at least one load-bearing assumption in the current PO-03 execution plan that evidence does not support.

acceptance.assertion: Each challenged assumption is stated, tested against committed evidence, and either upheld or flagged as a proposal; no proposal is treated as binding.
acceptance.falsified_if: a challenge is asserted without testing against committed evidence, or a proposal changes a decision

units.hypothesis: At least three materially different coordination topologies exist for this workload and can be compared on measured properties.

acceptance.assertion: Three or more topologies are specified concretely enough to be evaluated, and compared on collision, recovery and throughput using Wave A data or a runnable simulation.
acceptance.falsified_if: candidates are described without any measured or simulated comparison

units.hypothesis: There is useful in-scope work neither the founder nor this commission named, discoverable from the repository itself.

acceptance.assertion: At least one discovered opportunity is implemented and tested inside the PO-03 allowlist, not merely proposed.
acceptance.falsified_if: discovery produces only a list

units.hypothesis: The operator taxonomy and state contract contain ambiguities that a machine check can catch before they cause misrouting.

acceptance.assertion: An executable semantic check runs inside the PO-03 allowlist, reports ambiguities against the current pointer chain, and passes the existing scripts/check_operator_taxonomy.py without weakening it.
acceptance.falsified_if: the check requires modifying files outside the allowlist

units.hypothesis: Criteria for the fault matrix frozen before seeing a2 conclusions will reject at least one insufficiently proven fault class.

acceptance.assertion: Frozen criteria are committed and hashed before a2 output is read, provable from git history, and applied verbatim at review time.
acceptance.falsified_if: criteria are edited after producer output is read

units.hypothesis: The PO-01 qualification results from a4 contain at least one claim that does not survive independent re-execution.

acceptance.assertion: Each a4 reproduction claim is independently re-executed from the pinned SHA by this reviewer and confirmed or refuted, with PO-01 never written.
acceptance.falsified_if: claims are reviewed by reading rather than re-executing

units.hypothesis: The coordinator's own control plane contains at least one custody gap that its author did not test.

acceptance.assertion: An adversarial audit of control_plane.py by a non-author owner produces executable attack cases; each either breaks an invariant or documents the boundary reached.
acceptance.falsified_if: the audit produces opinions without executable cases

units.hypothesis: Independent disposition of GPT-produced cohorts will surface a different defect profile than same-family review would.

acceptance.assertion: Every reviewed unit receives ACCEPTED or REJECTED tied to frozen criteria, and the defect profile is compared against the a6 profile on overlapping artifacts.
acceptance.artifact: disposition rows plus comparative defect profile
acceptance.falsified_if: dispositions lack rationale or no comparison is made
